name: unravel-code
description: Explain selected code or a regex, step by step, in Turkish or English.

enumDescriptions: Use the locally installed Claude Code and your Claude subscription. No API key needed.
Use the locally installed OpenAI Codex and your ChatGPT subscription. No API key needed. Note: the answer appears all at once rather than streaming.
Use a model registered by another extension - e.g. the official ChatGPT extension (your ChatGPT subscription) or GitHub Copilot, including its free tier. No API key needed.
Use a stored API key when there is one, otherwise Claude Code.
Always use the Anthropic API key stored in SecretStorage.
unravelCode.auth.description: Where the credential comes from. The default 'claudeCode' uses a locally installed Claude Code and bills your Claude subscription - no API key, nothing for Unravel to store.

unravelCode.claudeCodePath.description: Absolute path to the Claude Code executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

unravelCode.codexPath.description: Absolute path to the Codex executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

unravelCode.codexModel.description: Model for Codex mode. Leave empty to use whatever Codex itself is configured with; unravelCode.model only applies to the Claude paths.

unravelCode.lmPreferred.description: In 'vscodeLm' mode, which provider to prefer. Matched against the model's vendor and family, e.g. 'openai' for the ChatGPT extension, 'copilot', or 'claude'. Leave empty to pick automatically.

unravelCode.language.description: Explanation language. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language.

unravelCode.model.description: Anthropic model used to generate explanations.

unravelCode.contextLines.description: Lines of surrounding code (before/after the selection) sent along for context. 0 sends only the selection.
